arcs.title: Bậc Thang Thứ Ba Mươi Ba
arcs.mechanism: conflicting certified building records plus a bounded spatial anomaly
arcs.dominant_question: What was omitted and where did the missing people go?
arcs.antagonist_motive: protect an old cover-up and living dependents
arcs.moral_dilemma: preserve truth despite foreseeable personal and social damage
arcs.solution_style: survey measurements + provenance of independent records + rescue coordination
arcs.cost: hero publicly takes responsibility; physical and relational damage
arcs.world_reveal: similar discrepancies may exist beyond one building
